chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Ya'qub b. Yazid narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi Umayr narrated to us, from Aban b. Uthman, from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them both). He said:

Indeed the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said one day to Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari: O Jabir! You will remain until you meet my descendant Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Ali b. Abi Talib, known in the Torah as al-Baqir. When you meet him, deliver my salaam to him. So Jabir visited Ali b. al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) and found Muhammad b. Ali (peace be upon them both) with him as a young boy. He said to him: O boy, come forward! So he came forward. Then he said: Turn around! So he turned around. Jabir said: The qualities of the Messenger of God, by the Lord of the Ka'ba! Then he turned to Ali b. al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) and said: Who is this? He said: This is my son and the patron of the Order after me, Muhammad al-Baqir. So Jabir rose and fell upon his feet, kissing them, and said: May my soul be sacrificed for yours, O son of the Messenger of God! Accept the greeting of your father. Indeed the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) sends you his salaam. He said: Then the eyes of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) filled with tears. Then he said: O Jabir! Peace be upon my father, the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family), as long as the heavens and the earth endure. And upon you too, O Jabir, for delivering the greeting.

key_terms.الباقر: Al-Baqir (the one who splits knowledge) - title of the fifth Imam foretold by the Prophet
key_terms.شمائل رسول الله: The qualities of the Messenger of God - Jabir's recognition of prophetic features in the young Imam
key_terms.صاحب الأمر: Patron of the Order - title of authority and succession in the Imamate

ai.seo_question: How did Jabir al-Ansari meet Imam al-Baqir as foretold by the Prophet?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates that the Prophet (SAWW) told Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari that he would live long enough to meet his descendant Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn, known in the Torah as al-Baqir, and instructed him to deliver his salaam. Jabir later visited Imam Zayn al-Abidin and found the young Muhammad b. Ali with him. After testing the boy by asking him to come forward and turn around, Jabir recognized the prophetic qualities in him. Learning he was the patron of the Order after his father, Jabir fell at his feet, kissed them, and delivered the Prophet's greeting. Imam al-Baqir's eyes filled with tears as he returned peace upon the Prophet and thanked Jabir for delivering the message.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Ya`qub b. Yazid narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr narrated to us from Aban b. `Uthman from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as).

He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said one day to Jabir b. `Abdullah al-Ansari: O Jabir! Surely, you will remain until you meet my descendant Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib, known in the Torah as “Baqir” (the one who splits and dissects knowledge). When you meet him, then deliver my salaam to him. So, Jabir visited `Ali b. al-Husayn (as), and he saw Muhammad b. `Ali (as) with him as a young boy. So, he said to him: O boy! Come forward. So, he came forward. Then, he said to him: Come near. So, he came near. So, Jabir said: The [same] sublime qualities of the Messenger of Allah (shama’il rasulAllah), by the Lord of the Ka`ba. Then, `Ali b. al-Husayn (as) came forward. So, he (Jabir) said to him: Who is this? He said: This is my son and the patron of the Order after me, Muhammad al-Baqir. So, Jabir fell to his feet and kissed them, saying: May my soul be your sacrifice, O son of the Messenger of Allah! The salaam of your father has been accepted. Surely, the Messenger of Allah (s) delivers the salaam to you. He said: So, the eyes of Abi Ja`far (as) filled with tears. Then, he said: O Jabir! Peace be unto my father, the Messenger of Allah (s), so long as heaven and Earth persist; and to you to, Jabir, for delivering the salaam.
